description: This file implements the 'Library' class responsible for dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and cleanup within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It handles platform-specific code for Linux and Windows, manages external dependencies, and provides mechanisms for safe resource management.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class managing dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and cleanup across Linux and Windows platforms.

methods.name: Library()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing internal handles and error string.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructor that loads a dynamic library given its filename, handling platform-specific loading mechanisms.

methods.name: Library(const Library& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor that shares the handle and increases reference count.

methods.name: ~Library()
methods.description: Destructor that releases the library handle and associated resources.

methods.name: Library& operator=(const Library& RHS)
methods.description: Assignment operator that manages reference counting and handle sharing.

methods.name: void* LoadFunction(const TCHAR functionName[])
methods.description: Loads a symbol (function) from the loaded library, handling errors if symbol not found.

methods.name: void AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the library handle.

methods.name: uint32_t Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads the library if count reaches zero, performing cleanup.
